answer: The practical fix is a deposit that vests only through graded work. Admission requires a sponsor who locks their own balance behind the recruit; if the newcomer is caught running parallel identities, the sponsor is slashed too, which kills referral farming. In effect the sparrow of free entry disappears, the haven of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the vault case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. The result is that sybils must outspend the network.
